{
  "name": "lot-map",
  "version": "0.12.0",
  "description": "A live map beside the chat: memory, files, shell, web, model, agents, skills and hooks light up as they are used",
  "author": {
    "name": "Aleksei Volodin",
    "url": "https://github.com/alexeyw"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/alexeyw/lot-map",
  "repository": "https://github.com/alexeyw/lot-map",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/alexeyw/lot-map/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/alexeyw/lot-map/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "keywords": ["mod", "map", "visualization", "activity", "tool calls", "hooks", "subagents", "memory"],
  "license": "MIT",
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "options": [
        "en",
        "ru",
        "es",
        "fr",
        "de",
        "it",
        "pt"
      ],
      "default": "en",
      "description": "The language of the labels on the map."
    },
    "coreName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name at the centre",
      "default": "CLAUDE",
      "description": "What the circle in the middle of the map says, up to ten characters."
    },
    "memoryServers": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Memory servers",
      "default": [
        "memory"
      ],
      "description": "MCP servers whose tools light the Memory station."
    },
    "memoryCommands": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Memory commands",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Shell commands or scripts that light the Memory station. A name counts when it is the command itself or begins with it and a hyphen, an underscore or a dot."
    },
    "memorySubcommands": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Memory subcommands",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Words after a memory command that the map may show, such as add or search. Without them a memory command goes by its own name, because the word after it may be content."
    },
    "memoryPaths": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Memory paths",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Parts of a path that make a file a memory. Claude Code's own memory folder always counts."
    },
    "memoryLabels": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Memory labels",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Short names for memory tools, each written as tool=name. A tool without one goes by its own name."
    },
    "serverStations": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Servers on a station",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Put an MCP server's tools on a station of the map, each written as server=station. The stations are files, shell, web, browser, agents, skills and you. Memory keeps memoryServers, which wins if a server is in both. A server without an entry, or with an unknown station, goes where the mod puts it."
    },
    "hookRecords": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Hooks add numbered records",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Turn on if a hook of yours adds memory records numbered like [#123]: the map then shows them on the Memory station, by number only. It counts such numbers in the text of any hook, not only a memory one."
    },
    "hookReasons": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show why a hook refused",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Show the first line of a hook's refusal, up to 72 characters. Off, the map says only which tool was stopped: a refusal may quote what the hook found."
    },
    "guardedHooks": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Hooks a guard skips",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Turn off on a Team or Enterprise login where the transcript gets notices that a lot-map hook was skipped. The map then loses the Hooks station, the records a hook adds, the row of a typed slash command and the mark of a compaction; everything else stays."
    },
    "openAtStart": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open the pane when a session starts",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Off, the pane stays closed until you type /lot-map. The map is kept from the session's first call all the same, so it is whole when you open it."
    },
    "subagentNames": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Name subagents in the rows",
      "default": false,
      "description": "A subagent's model step says which subagent it is, by the few words it was started with, up to 40 characters. Off, it says only that it is a subagent."
    },
    "contextCost": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "What each call adds to the context",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Each row says about how many tokens the context grew by with its call's answer, and the map adds each station's sum to its count. An estimate: the growth of one model step, which also holds the model's own words, what hooks added and, at the start of a turn, the message, shared among that step's calls. It shows one step late, and a call whose step was the last of a turn gets none."
    },
    "contextWindow": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "What the ring measures against",
      "options": [
        "model",
        "compaction"
      ],
      "default": "model",
      "description": "What the ring around the centre and its percentage measure the context against: model, the model's whole window, as the status line does; or compaction, the auto-compact window, such as one set with autoCompactWindow, where it is smaller than the model's. Without one, or with auto-compaction off, compaction shows the same as model."
    },
    "theme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Colours",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "dark",
        "light"
      ],
      "default": "auto",
      "description": "The map's colours: dark, light, or auto, which is dark on a dark surface and light on a light one."
    },
    "background": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Background",
      "options": [
        "solid",
        "transparent"
      ],
      "default": "solid",
      "description": "The map's own background, or transparent, which lets the pane behind it show through."
    },
    "paneBackground": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pane background",
      "default": "theme",
      "description": "What the pane is painted with: theme, Claude Code's own; transparent, which lets the terminal behind it show through; or a colour written as #rrggbb."
    },
    "colors": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Colours of your own",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Colours that replace the map's own, each written as name=#rrggbb. Names: background, node, line, spoke, text, label, faint, accent, active, error, memory, memoryActive, route. Set theme to dark or light with them."
    },
    "layout": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Layout",
      "options": [
        "you-top",
        "you-bottom"
      ],
      "default": "you-top",
      "description": "Where you are on the map: at the top, or at the bottom with the network and the browser at the top."
    },
    "motion": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Motion",
      "options": [
        "full",
        "reduced"
      ],
      "default": "full",
      "description": "With reduced, nothing on the map flies, spreads or spins: a call lights its station and its spoke, and what changes only fades."
    },
    "textSize": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Text size",
      "options": [
        "caption",
        "footnote",
        "body"
      ],
      "default": "footnote",
      "description": "The size of the rows under the map: caption is smaller, body larger. A terminal has one size and ignores it."
    },
    "logRows": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Rows under the map",
      "options": [
        "16",
        "fill"
      ],
      "default": "16",
      "description": "How many rows the list under the map shows: 16, or fill, as many as the pane has room for below the map, never fewer than 16. Fill is for the desktop app's docked pane; a terminal, the editor and the mobile app keep 16."
    },
    "terminalView": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Terminal view",
      "options": [
        "text",
        "picture",
        "braille"
      ],
      "default": "text",
      "description": "How the map looks in a terminal: text, the rows alone; picture, the map itself above them, painted by the mod, in a terminal that shows pictures such as kitty, Ghostty or iTerm2 from 3.7.8, not in an earlier iTerm2, which keeps every frame in memory; or braille, the map above them in braille dots and letters, in any terminal whose font has braille, such as Windows Terminal."
    },
    "cellShape": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Terminal cell shape",
      "default": 2.4,
      "description": "For the terminal picture: how many times taller a terminal cell is than it is wide, so that the picture fills its box. About 2.4 for iTerm2's Monaco 12, about 2 for Menlo in kitty. Raise it if the map leaves an empty band below it or looks stretched tall; lower it if the band is at its right or the map looks squashed. From 1.2 to 4."
    }
  }
}
